title: Vegetable and Fruit Juice Drink with High Vitamin C

content.title: About
content.content: The vegetable and fruit juice drink is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from a blend of fresh vegetables and fruits, fortified with vitamin C. It contains no added sugar, fits a diet plan, and easily integrates into daily nutrition.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Combining vegetables and fruits provides a broad spectrum of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants.
Vitamin C is stabilized to retain its activity even after extended storage.
The drink is often used in sports nutrition for rapid recovery after exercise.
Its low calorie content makes it popular among weight‑conscious consumers.
Manufacturers frequently add lime or lemon extract to boost flavor and vitamin C levels.

items.title: High vitamin C content
items.content: Vitamin C supports immune function, collagen synthesis, and enhances iron absorption.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids and carotenoids from the fruits and vegetables help neutralize free radicals.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: The drink provides a substantial amount of water and electrolytes, aiding fluid balance.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Absence of added sugar makes it suitable for diet regimens.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Fiber from the fruit and vegetable blend promotes regular bowel movements.

items.title: Allergy to specific ingredients
items.content: The beverage may contain fruits or vegetables that trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate the stomach lining in individuals with gastritis.

items.title: Added sugar in some variants
items.content: Certain versions may contain added sugar; always check the label.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Consume the drink chilled as a refreshing snack, post‑workout recovery, or alongside a light breakfast. It can also be blended into smoothies or used as a base for cocktails.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C. After opening, consume within 3‑5 days. Do not freeze, as this may alter taste and texture.
